title: 004 白虎稍强
content_zh:
“你好，叶娴。”叶娴大方的伸出手，跟唐振东握了一下。

“进来吧，赶紧进来！”老叶扯着叶娴和拉着唐振东进了屋。

“我妈在厨房洗菜呢，你们先坐，我马上去炒菜，一会就好。”叶娴说起母亲在厨房，她也顾不得跟老爸闲聊，就进了厨房。

唐振东坐下不动声色的往四周看了看，老叶家生活也不算太如意。虽然不说家徒四壁，但是家里没有一样现代化的电器，都是些老货色。

“你嫂子她身体不大好，今天是我闺女主厨，她打打下手，呵呵。”老叶边给唐振东倒水，边说。

看来自己没进楼前看的挺准，果然是老叶家那口子有病。

“老叶，好了，好了。”唐振东不动声色的扶起老叶倒水的茶杯。

叶娴炒菜的手脚很麻利，很快一个四十多岁的女人从厨房出来，端了一盘菜，“这就是小唐吧？我们家老叶经常跟我说，他有个小邻居，经常帮他招揽客人，呵呵，多谢你啦。来了这里就跟到了自己家一样，千万别拘束，随便点就行。”老叶嫂说话风风火火，语气很快，但是唐振东仔细看，她的疾厄宫上有块黑痣，并且颜色晦暗，再加上唐振东看她端盘子时候，不自觉的手足微微震颤，这是心脏有病的表现。

疾厄宫就是人鼻子山根的部位，有肉，发亮，有红光，表明身体健康，而晦暗、有痣则代表了身体某一方面有疾病。

“我说你个老叶，以前进门都轻手轻脚的，今天怎么回事，是带了客人回来展扬的还是怎么的，把个门差点都给我敲坏了，我在厨房就仿佛打雷似的。”叶嫂放下盘子后，就喋喋不休，老叶一句话不说，只是唯唯诺诺，看来在老叶家里，的确是老叶嫂主持全面家务。

“这不是女儿回来了，我高兴的嘛。”老叶看老伴一直喋喋不休，他回了一句，然后朝唐振东的方向努努嘴，意思是有客人在，你总得给我留点面子吧。

老叶嫂这才讪讪笑了，“小唐，你坐，我去端菜。”

“嫂子，别太麻烦，随便点就行。”

“你嫂子就是刀子嘴豆腐心这么个人。”老叶似乎也为刚才老伴呵斥自己摸不开脸，急忙解释。

时间不长，一桌子丰盛至极的饭菜就做好了，老叶拿出酒，“小唐，喝点白的还是啤的？”

“都行，我随你，不过我酒量不行。”

“没事，喝多喝少看你自己，都不是外人。”

“那好，我就少喝点。”唐振东没喝过酒，这是第一次。在监狱之前，他还上学，所以根本也没机会喝酒。

“小唐，多吃点。”老叶老伴招呼唐振东。

“好的，嫂子，我能吃饱，呵呵，到哪里去都能吃饱肚子。”

唐振东这说的可都是实话，以前在村里出来的，本来就不是个挑食的孩子，而且又在监狱里熬了八年。在监狱里，吃饭可绝对是个大事，而且是最大的事。有钱的好说，在那里什么都可以买到，但是你没有钱，肯定也饿不死，只是吃的饭一点油水都没有，白菜就是水煮出来的，见不到一点荤腥。遇到心眼不好使的管教，那就惨了，故意在发霉的米饭里撒上沙子，吃就吃，不吃拉倒。

但是唐振东是排头。排头，排头，就是站队时候排在头里的，也是整个监室的老大，而老大不光睡觉的位置最好，而且整个监室谁的家人要捎东西来，那都要通过老大的手，老大说给看上这个，那这个必须给老大。有钱的人在监狱里也过的很好，很多贪官在监狱里除了没有自由外，吃的倒也不受罪，在里面有钱基本什么都可以买到，当然这些指的是袋装速食食品，要想吃炒菜，那就没办法了。很多人的高血压高血脂，都因为在监狱里面呆了几年而完全康复，这也不能不说是个奇迹。

监狱里只出来两种人，一种是彻底被改造好了的人，另一种则是畸形的环境更加扭曲了心理的人，这种人出来以后，会疯狂的报复社会。这两种人是两个极端。

唐振东就是那种被改造好了的人。当然这其中也离不开他师父的教诲。其实唐振东在监狱里当排头只当了两年，随后就遇到了他的师父，然后就跟着师父一起住。具体的事情以后会交代。

唐振东的这句嫂子刚说完，引起了在座的一位小美女的抗议，“妈，他怎么叫你嫂子，这不是凭空给我降了一辈吗，这是典型的占我便宜。”

老叶哈哈大笑，赶紧给闺女夹菜，“娴娴，我的好闺女，你都是大学生了，怎么还凭空计较这些小事，小唐是爹的朋友，我们一直是平辈论交，按辈分你的确是低了一辈。”

唐振东赶紧摇手，“我们还是各交各的，不用这么刻意。”虽然是个小女孩，但是唐振东不会因为这种小事故意树敌。

“呵呵，好，各交各的好。”老叶老伴一开口，老叶自然就赶紧知趣的闭上嘴。唐振东看到这种情况，就只有低头夹菜，装作看不见。

“闺女回来，今天可要好好庆祝下。”老叶率先举起杯跟倒满可乐的叶娴碰了杯，唐振东也举起杯作陪。

唐振东虽然从里面出来，但是自有一股泰山崩于前，而面不改色的气度，这让老叶老伴黄秀琴越看越顺眼。

唐振东长的不错，架的起细端量，说是帅也毫不为过。最主要的是唐振东有股淡定的气质，不卑不亢，这让黄秀琴有种丈母娘看女婿，越看越爱看的感觉。不过唐振东的这个身份似乎是差了点，不过要是人好的话，那未来也不是就这么定下来的。

唐振东眼中除了带着中让人容易相信的信任外，而且还带有一种善于应变的光。善于应变跟容易让人取得信任，这是对人两种截然不同的观感，但是却完美的体现在唐振东一个人的身上。

唐振东第一次喝酒，有些不胜酒力，他练的是鬼谷气功，对于自己的思想可以控制的非常好。他感觉到自己有些想醉的意思，自己就停下不喝了。只是夹夹菜而已。

老叶虽然是一个假期没见女儿，但是却从未对女儿的学习询问过，只是问了句学校生活的话，唐振东能看的出来，老叶对自己的女儿很自豪。

京城大学是整个华夏最好的大学，能靠上京城大学的，都是天之娇子，都是在整个省里排的上前十的人物。

或许如果自己没有那次失手杀人，那恐怕自己也会有机会考上京城大学的吧！唐振东小时候就特别聪明，虽然从来不写作业，但是却总是考第一。在镇上上初中的时候，因为不写作业，唐振东还经常被老师叫起来站着听课。但是这种情况只持续了一两个月，唐振东的学习成绩，让所有老师都大感惊讶，别人不会做的题，他都会，虽然他从来不做作业。每个学科都是这样。

唐振东不光聪明，而且记忆力特别好，这都不算，唐振东的体育老师因为唐振东的身体素质特别好，跟他们班的班主任，都打到了校长那里去，就为了让唐振东从事体育。不过校长权衡了下，还是让唐振东学习。

因为体育生一般是在文化课特别不理想的时候，才该学体育，如果文化课好，那老师是不会让一个孩子学体育的。

唐振东的身体素质好到什么程度，学校围墙是一米八的铁栏杆，唐振东一个助跑，就能空翻过去。也就是说他弹跳力非常好，除此之外，唐振东的耐力也非常强，在初中的时候男子五千米的运动会上，唐振东总拿第一。

不过这些都是过去了，唐振东在刚进去的时候，还偶尔畅想一下他曾经可以拥有的未来，不过现在，他的心很平静，稍微带着些许的迷茫。
content_en:
"Hello, Ye Xian." Ye Xian generously stretched out her hand and shook Tang Zhendong's hand.

"Come in, come in quickly!" Lao Ye pulled Ye Xian and Tang Zhendong into the house.

"My mother is washing vegetables in the kitchen. You guys sit down first. I'll start cooking in a minute. I'll be ready in a moment." Ye Xian said that her mother was in the kitchen, and she didn't care to chat with her father and went into the kitchen.

Tang Zhendong sat down and looked around calmly. Life in Lao Ye's family was not too satisfactory.Although the house is not bare, there are no modern appliances in the house, they are all old stuff.

"Your sister-in-law is not in good health. My daughter is the chef today and she is the assistant, haha." Lao Ye said while pouring water for Tang Zhendong.

It seems that I saw it correctly before entering the building. Sure enough, the old Ye family member is sick.

"Lao Ye, okay, okay." Tang Zhendong calmly helped Lao Ye pour the tea cup.

Ye Xian was very good at cooking, and soon a woman in her forties came out of the kitchen and brought a plate of dishes, "Is this Xiao Tang? Our old Ye often told me that he had a little neighbor who often helped him attract customers. Haha, thank you very much. When you come here, it feels like you are at your own home., Don't be restrained, just be casual." Old Mrs. Ye spoke in a fiery tone, but Tang Zhendong looked carefully and saw that there was a black mole on her palace of illness, and it was dark in color. In addition, when Tang Zhendong watched her serving the dishes, his hands and feet were trembling slightly, which was a sign of heart disease.

The Disease Palace is the part at the base of the nose. It is fleshy, shiny, and red, indicating good health. Darkness and moles represent disease in some aspect of the body.

"I'm telling you, Lao Ye, you used to walk in the door very lightly. What happened today? Did you bring guests back to show off or something? I almost broke the door. I was like thunder in the kitchen." After Mrs. Ye put down the plate, she kept chattering. Lao Ye didn't say a word and was just obedient. It seems that in Lao Ye's house, Mrs. Ye is indeed in charge of all the housework.

"I'm not happy that my daughter is back." Seeing that his wife kept chattering, Lao Ye replied, and then licked his lips in the direction of Tang Zhendong, meaning that there are guests here, so you have to save some face for me.

Mrs. Ye then smiled and said, "Xiao Tang, sit down and I'll serve the food."

"Sister-in-law, don't be too troublesome, just be casual."

"Your sister-in-law is such a mean-spirited person." Lao Ye seemed to be embarrassed by his wife scolding him just now, so he hurriedly explained.

In a short time, a table of sumptuous meals was ready. Lao Ye took out the wine and said, "Xiao Tang, would you like something white or beer?"

"It's okay, I'll follow you, but I don't have the ability to drink."

"It's okay. If you drink more or less, it's up to you. You're not an outsider."

"Okay, I'll drink less." This was the first time Tang Zhendong had never drank.Before prison, he was still in school, so he had no chance to drink.

"Xiao Tang, eat more." Mr. Ye greeted Tang Zhendong.

"Okay, sister-in-law, I can eat enough. Haha, I can always have a full stomach wherever I go."

What Tang Zhendong said was true. He was not a picky eater when he came out of the village, and he spent eight years in prison.In prison, eating is definitely a big thing, and it is the biggest thing.It's easy for those who have money, you can buy everything there, but if you don't have money, you will definitely not starve to death. It's just that the food you eat has no oil or water at all. The cabbage is just boiled, and there is no meat at all.It would be terrible if you encountered a mischievous discipline officer who deliberately sprinkled sand into the moldy rice and would eat it when you ate it.

But Tang Zhendong is the leader.The head of the queue, the head of the queue, is the person who is at the head of the queue when standing in line, and is also the boss of the entire cell. Not only does the boss have the best sleeping position, but also if any family member in the entire cell wants to bring something, it must go through the boss. If the boss wants this, then this must be given to the boss.Rich people also live a good life in prison. In addition to having no freedom, many corrupt officials are not punished for eating in prison. If you have money, you can buy basically anything. Of course, these refer to bagged instant food. If you want to eat stir-fried vegetables, there is no way.Many people with high blood pressure and high blood lipids have completely recovered from their high blood pressure and high blood lipids after spending several years in prison. This cannot but be said to be a miracle.

There are only two types of people who come out of prison, one is a person who has been completely reformed, and the other is a person whose abnormal environment has further distorted their psychology. After such people come out, they will crazily retaliate against society.These two kinds of people are two extremes.

Tang Zhendong is the kind of person who has been transformed.Of course, this is also inseparable from the teachings of his master.In fact, Tang Zhendong only served as a platoon leader in prison for two years. Then he met his master and then lived with him.The specific matters will be explained later.

Tang Zhendong had just finished saying the words "sister-in-law", which aroused the protest of a young beauty present, "Mom, why did he call you sister-in-law? Didn't he demote me a generation out of thin air? This is a typical example of taking advantage of me."

Lao Ye laughed heartily and hurriedly served his daughter some food, "Xianxian, my good daughter, you are already a college student, why are you still fussing over these trivial matters out of thin air? Xiao Tang is dad's friend and we have always been friends. You are indeed a generation below us."

Tang Zhendong quickly waved his hand, "We still have our own lives, there's no need to be so deliberate." Although she is a little girl, Tang Zhendong will not deliberately make enemies over such trivial matters.

"Haha, okay, let's do our own thing." As soon as Lao Ye's wife opened her mouth, Lao Ye naturally shut up quickly and knowingly.When Tang Zhendong saw this situation, he could only lower his head to pick up the vegetables and pretend not to see it.

"My daughter is back, let's celebrate today." Lao Ye took the lead in raising his glass and clinked it with Ye Xian who filled the Coke. Tang Zhendong also raised his glass to accompany him.

Although Tang Zhendong came out of it, he had an air of calm expression even though the mountain was falling in front of him, which made Lao Ye's wife Huang Xiuqin more and more pleased with him.

Tang Zhendong is good-looking and has a delicate frame. It is no exaggeration to say he is handsome.The most important thing is that Tang Zhendong has a calm temperament, neither humble nor overbearing. This makes Huang Xiuqin feel like a mother-in-law looking at her son-in-law, and the more she looks at her, the more she loves him.However, Tang Zhendong's identity seems to be a bit lacking, but if he is a good person, his future will not be decided like this.

In addition to the trust that makes people easy to believe, Tang Zhendong's eyes also have a light that is adaptable.Being good at adapting and being easy to gain trust are two completely different perceptions of people, but they are perfectly reflected in Tang Zhendong.

Tang Zhendong drank for the first time and was a little overwhelmed. He practiced Guigu Qigong and could control his thoughts very well.He felt like he was getting drunk, so he stopped drinking.It's just a side dish.

Although Lao Ye hadn't seen his daughter for a holiday, he had never asked about his daughter's studies. He only asked about school life. Tang Zhendong could tell that Lao Ye was very proud of his daughter.

Jingcheng University is the best university in China. Those who can get into Jingcheng University are all the darlings of heaven, and they are among the top ten in the entire province.

Maybe if I hadn't accidentally killed someone, I'm afraid I would have had the chance to be admitted to Capital University!Tang Zhendong was very smart when he was a child. Although he never did homework, he always came first in exams.When he was in junior high school in the town, Tang Zhendong was often asked by his teacher to stand up and listen to class because he didn't do his homework.But this situation only lasted for a month or two. Tang Zhendong's academic performance surprised all the teachers. He could do the questions that others couldn't do, although he never did his homework.This is true in every discipline.

Tang Zhendong is not only smart, but also has a very good memory. Not only that, Tang Zhendong's physical education teacher and their class teacher went to the principal because of Tang Zhendong's very good physical fitness, just to let Tang Zhendong engage in sports.However, after careful consideration, the principal decided to let Tang Zhendong study.

Because physical education students generally should learn physical education when their cultural classes are particularly unsatisfactory. If their cultural classes are good, the teacher will not let a child learn physical education.

How good is Tang Zhendong's physical fitness? The school wall is a 1.8-meter iron railing, and Tang Zhendong can flip over it with just a running start.In other words, his jumping ability is very good. In addition, Tang Zhendong also has very strong endurance. In junior high school, Tang Zhendong always took first place in the men's 5,000-meter sports meeting.

But these are all in the past. When Tang Zhendong first entered, he occasionally thought about the future he could have had, but now, his heart is very calm, with a little confusion.
